partners.mechanism_chain: MYH9 (HGNC:7506) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal organization and cell adhesion (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal organization and cell adhesion (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal tympanic membrane morphology (HP:0030970); WHRN (HGNC:13100) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal organization and cell adhesion (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal organization and cell adhesion (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365).
